# Vanity.box

> Vanity.box (also known as Vanity, Vanity Wallet, Vanity ID, Vanity Web3) turns long crypto wallet addresses into one readable vanity name and a unified cross-chain Web3 profile.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://vanity.box/): search any name and view Web3 profiles
- [Vanity.box profile](https://vanity.box/vanity.box)
- [Privacy Policy](https://vanity.box/privacy-policy)
- [Terms of Use](https://vanity.box/terms-of-use)

## Supported
ENS (.eth, .box), Basenames, IOTA names, Unstoppable Domains (.vanity, .x), TON, Sui, Aptos, World Chain.
